findings.title: Bootstrap/publication/reconcile owner-state predicates conflict
findings.counterexample: BOOTING cannot satisfy commit OPEN guard; EVIDENCE_PENDING cannot satisfy reconcile OPEN guard despite state-table recovery.
findings.required_decision: Separate initial publication, replacement fence, and receipt-bound recovery predicates; CLOSING dominates.

findings.title: Reverse cleanup needs per-disposer producer-subtree join
findings.counterexample: D2 settles its timeout race while tracked cleanup IO Q still uses D1 resource; reverse loop advances to D1.
findings.required_decision: Join original disposer and its admitted descendants before advancing to dependent item, on all rollback/late-cleanup paths.

findings.title: Authenticated agent snapshots lack an aggregate retained-size charge
findings.counterexample: 2048 valid 16KiB instruction strings require 32MiB payload before overhead for one full pin snapshot; only plan/config has aggregate 256KiB rule.
findings.required_decision: Total snapshot byte/node/depth bounds, quota reservation before cloning/hash/policy, terminal snapshot release.

findings.title: Release self-waits and policy/read recursion are outside concrete reentrancy rule
findings.counterexample: Audit callback waits release receipt containing its own original IO; policy callback inventory recursively authorizes through same port.
findings.required_decision: Native dependency-aware waiting/read recursion rule for all owned callback phases, not only close receipt/mutation queue.

findings.title: Versioned canonical AuditEvent.action disagrees with publication literals
findings.counterexample: plugin.lifecycle.v1.published and plugin.lifecycle.published are distinct persisted action strings for the same proposed event.
findings.required_decision: Freeze exact kind/phase/action table for bootstrap, replace and reconcile, including unknown/failed attempts.
